Typical project path From review to implementation. Most projects move through a sequence of understanding, strategy, communication and delivery. The emphasis changes depending on the course, the club and the nature of the work. 01 Review Understand the course, its history, landscape, current pressures and the ambitions of the club. 02 Strategy Develop a clear architectural direction, identifying priorities, dependencies and opportunities for phased improvement. 03 Communication Prepare plans, visuals and presentation material that help committees and members understand the proposals. 04 Implementation Support the move from drawing to ground through phasing, site guidance, contractor coordination and practical refinement.
